findings.body: When creation fails because the member already belongs to 20 circles, the error handler only sets a specific message for a `name` field error. Otherwise this line shows the generic “Please try again” message, which does not tell the member why another circle was refused. The new end-to-end test expects “You can belong to at most 20 circles.” Handle the limit error explicitly.
